It commenced on 7 October 2022 and concluded with the [[2023 Indian Super League final|final]] on 18 March 2023.{{cite web |url=https://www.indiansuperleague.com/news/atk-mohun-bagan-become-hero-isl-champions-after-thrilling-penalty-shooutout-win-over-bengaluru-fc |title=ATK Mohun Bagan become Hero ISL Champions after thrilling penalty shootout win over Bengaluru FC |date=18 March 2023 |author=ISL Media Team |website=indiansuperleague.com |publisher=Indian Super League | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230318194230/https://www.indiansuperleague.com/news/atk-mohun-bagan-become-hero-isl-champions-after-thrilling-penalty-shooutout-win-over-bengaluru-fc |archive-date=18 March 2023 |url-status=live}} [[Jamshedpur FC|Jamshedpur]] were the defending premiers and [[Hyderabad FC|Hyderabad]] were the defending champions. [[Mumbai City FC|Mumbai City]] became champions by winning their second League Winners' Shield, and [[Mohun Bagan Super Giant|ATK Mohun Bagan]] won their first ISL cup title, defeating [[Bengaluru FC|Bengaluru]] in the final. ==Changes from last season== * Six instead of four clubs will compete for the playoffs. The top two clubs qualify directly for the playoffs, while the next four sides will play a single-legged match to decide the remaining two teams for the semifinals. The third-ranked team will play against the sixth-ranked team. Similarly, the fourth-ranked team will play against the fifth-ranked team, with the higher-ranked side hosting the match.{{cite web|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/91220633.cms?from=mdr|title=ISL to introduce six-team playoffs from next season|work=[[The Times of India]]|date=1 May 2022|access-date=1 May 2022|archive-date=2 September 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220902092542/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/goa/isl-to-introduce-six-team-playoffs-from-next-season/articleshow/91220633.cms?from=mdr|url-status=live}} * The traditional home and away format has returned. * The league will be played over five months for the first time. However, there was no break during the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]].{{cite web|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/goa/longer-isl-season-but-no-break-during-fifa-world-cup/articleshow/93935990.cms|title=Longer ISL season but no break during FIFA World Cup|work=[[The Times of India]]|date=24 October 2022|access-date=24 October 2022}} == Teams == Eleven teams played in the 2022–23 season. {{location map+ | India | float=right | width=385 | alt=Locations of the Indian Super League teams | caption=Locations of the Indian Super League teams | places= {{location map~ |India3 |lat=12.58 |long=77.34 |label=

the league qualify for the play-offs. ** The top two teams advance directly to the two-legged semi-finals. ** Teams ranked 3rd to 6th play a single-legged knockout round, hosted by the higher-ranked team. * '''Progression:''' ** Winners of the knockout stage join the top two teams in the semi-finals. ** Semi-finals are played over two legs to determine the finalists. ** The tournament culminates
